cards.title: Account, Subaccount and Region
cards.subtitle: SAP BTP Vibe Coding Workshop Prerequisites
cards.description: • Enterprise or Pay-As-You-Go global account. The SAP AI Core extended plan is paid; the free plan does not include the Generative AI Hub and cannot be used for this workshop. • A subaccount for the workshop (an existing one is fine). • A region in which SAP AI Core with the Generative AI Hub is offered (e.g., eu30 GCP Frankfurt or eu10 AWS Frankfurt). Check the SAP Discovery Center to confirm availability in your region. • Note: If you provision an optional database (PostgreSQL or SAP HANA Cloud), create it in the same subaccount as the Cloud Foundry space that hosts the application.
